_comment: Hand-verified venue-name -> place-id map. Automatic matching in build.py is deliberately strict (exact name, or a full distinctive-token subset) because a wrong venue on a page is worse than no venue: loose 'contains' matching produced Araksa Tea Garden -> 'Garden Restaurant' and Bua Bhat Factory -> 'Fact Cafe'. This file is where a human pins the ones strict matching cannot reach. Field truth, per data/curated/ convention — importers must never overwrite it. KEYS ARE STORED AS build.py's _vnorm() LEAVES THEM: lower-cased, every non-alphanumeric character collapsed to a single space. A key written 'UN Irish Pub & Restaurant' or "The Duke's" can never be hit, because the lookup normalises before it asks — that silently cost 6 of 90 venue matches on 2026-08-31 until the keys were rewritten. Note that _vnorm keeps the acute in 'cafe' vs 'cafe', so both spellings need their own key.
_precision: Use `approx: true` where the pinned record is the containing institution rather than the exact room or building, so the page can say so instead of implying a precise fix.

_missing_from_catalogue._comment: Event venues confirmed NOT present in the catalogue. An events feed naming a venue we do not have is itself a discovery signal, so this is a worklist, not a complaint. REVIEWED 2026-08-31 against the 31 Aug newsletter issue: of the five listed on 2026-07-29, Attika Studio and Lecker Cafe & Bistro are now records (cm-newsletter-*) and Araksa Tea Garden is cm-curated-araksa-tea-garden. The 31 Aug issue named 90 venues and every one of them now resolves — 62 became records, the rest are aliases onto places the catalogue already held under another spelling. What is left below is what nothing has yet supplied an address or a pin for.
